_note: Mock score model for the hackathon demo (2026-10-17). Each insurance has its own score from 0 to max_score; a new insurance starts at insurance_score_start. The insurance's score sets a discount on that insurance (bands). The aggregate score is the average of a customer's insurance scores and sets the tier, whose bonuses are display texts only. The backend seeds these into its database once; If staff edit them in the dashboard. The mobile app mirrors the numbers in mobile-app/src/data/mock.ts. fixtures/score-tiers.json is the older model behind /homes/me/score and stays as it is.
